queries.name: monthly_trend
queries.description: Sessions, total tokens, median non-empty window per calendar month.

queries.name: category_shares
queries.description: Token-weighted share per category per source, plus a source='all' grand-total row set.

queries.name: tool_ranking
queries.description: Per tool — total tokens, share of tool-result tokens, call count, tokens/call — overall (source='all') and per source.

queries.name: whale_table
queries.description: Top-N sessions by total_tokens with source, dominant category, duplicate count, wasted tokens, signals fired.

queries.name: duplicate_burden
queries.description: Sessions with duplicates and tokens in repeated content — count + share of all tokens, per source plus 'all'.

queries.name: tool_share_trend
queries.description: Per-tool share of tool-result tokens per calendar month.

queries.name: signal_frequency
queries.description: Share of sessions firing each bloat signal, per source. Mirrors the sweep report's signal_frequency block.

queries.name: category_outliers
queries.description: Sessions where a single category exceeds X% of the window.

queries.name: bloat_signals_by_tool
queries.description: Cross-tab — for sessions where a given signal fired, which tools dominate (tool-result tokens per label × tool).
